messages:
Matt B: quick sync — claiming facilitators for ARB over next 6 weeks. I added a sheet: https://tiny.redwood/arb-rotations. I'm proposing a 10-min "fast-pass" slot at start for urgent RFCs (light triage + commit to follow-ups). Please claim a week by EOD Fri or comment if you can't. Facilitator responsibilities: run meeting, timebox, assign note-taker, file follow-up issues. Also can we test 25m timebox + 5m wrap? :clock1:

Olivia K: prefer fast-pass at the end so we don't interrupt reviews. Could we instead have a 5-min "quickblock" at the end for urgent ops? keeps flow.

Dante P: I can take week of Apr 14 — added my name to the sheet.

Jas S: +1 on facilitator handoff. Can we add a repo label `arb/agenda` and ask facilitators to attach PRs/links? Also suggests a one-line TL;DR for each RFC in the agenda.

Samir R: can we rotate note-taker too? I can take notes for Dante's week. @eng-sre FYI for any ops items that might need fast-pass.

Calendar Bot: Meeting created: Architecture Review Board — Wed 10:00 UTC recurring weekly. Invite sent to eng-platform, arch, eng-ml.

Matt B: updated the sheet and created the `arb/agenda` label. Agenda template below:
```
1) Quick announcements (3m)
2) Fast-pass RFCs (10m) — up to 2 quick items (5m each)
3) Main RFC review (25m)
4) Action items & next steps (5m)
```
Facilitator: add links under your week, assign note-taker, add label to PRs. Please also add a 1-line summary for each RFC.

Dante P: I'll volunteer as note-taker for my week unless someone else wants it.

Olivia K: minor ask — can we reserve the third slot for platform-standards only? Keeps ARB focused; ops urgent things go to fast-pass.

Jas S: added "rollout checklist" to week 2 on the sheet.

Matt B: thanks all. If no objections we'll adopt this rotation and template for the next 6 meetings. :thumbsup:
